description: SIMOUV - Horaires Théoriques Et Temps Réel De Transport Public TRANSVILLES VALENCIENNES is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Syndicat Intercommunal de Mobilité et d'Organisation Urbaine du Valenciennois. List of stops, schedules and routes of the Transvilles network operating on the territory of SIMOUV in GTFS and GTFS-RT format. Coverage: Syndicat Intercommunal de Mobilité et d'Organisation Urbaine du Valenciennois. The portal shows the English title as "SIMOUV — Theoretical and Real Time Transport Schedules Public Transvilles VALENCIENNES" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Syndicat Intercommunal de Mobilité et d'Organisation Urbaine du Valenciennois. Its keywords include gtfs-rt, transvilles, simouv, gtfs, valenciennes, siri. The listing shows 1 download or service links in GTFS. The listing shows 2023-02-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
